title: Thapar Japan Hackathon
about.strategicdescription: Connecting theoretical knowledge with practical industry application. Our three-pillar approach ensures value for both sponsors and participants.
about.pillar1.title: Real Problems
about.pillar1.description: Sponsors submit operational challenges directly from their factory floors or management systems, seeking innovative, scalable solutions.
about.pillar2.title: Top Talent
about.pillar2.description: Access to Thapar Institute's best engineers. A curated environment where raw technical ability meets disciplined problem-solving.
about.pillar3.title: Hiring Pipeline
about.pillar3.description: Direct internships and recruitment opportunities. Evaluate potential candidates based on practical performance under pressure, not just resumes.
footer.copyright: © 2026 Thapar Japan Hackathon. All rights reserved. In partnership with TSLAS and Thapar Institute.
timeline.title: Event Roadmap
timeline.description: Mark your calendars. A rigorous schedule designed to push boundaries, test ideas, and culminate in a premier showcase of talent.
timeline.item1.title: Company Onboarding
timeline.item1.description: Japanese industry partners come aboard, define their tracks, and submit the real-world problem statements that teams will tackle.
timeline.item2.title: Participant Team Registration
timeline.item2.description: Applications open to students. Form your team, pick your track, and lock in your place in the hackathon.
timeline.item3.title: Internal Shortlisting
timeline.item3.description: Submissions are reviewed and the most promising teams are shortlisted to advance to the main event.
timeline.item4.title: Hackathon
timeline.item4.description: Two days of intense building, mentorship, and final pitches to a panel of industry judges. Winners and internship offers announced.
ps.title: Problem Statements
ps.description: Industry challenges from leading Japanese partners will be revealed here soon. Prepare to tackle complex, real-world problems that demand precision, innovation, and global foresight.
partners.title: Our Partners
partners.description: Meet the industry leaders shaping the future of innovation. Our curated network of corporate partners provides vital resources, mentorship, and real-world problem statements to our hacker community.
partners.claimdescription: Position your brand at the forefront of the Thapar Japan Hackathon alongside top-tier talent.
partner.requestsent.description: Our corporate relations team will contact you shortly.
partner.description: Join forces with the brightest young minds at Thapar Japan Hackathon. We invite industry leaders to collaborate, mentor, and discover top-tier talent ready to solve real-world challenges.
partner.request.description: Fill out the form below and our corporate relations team will contact you shortly.
about.description: Thapar Japan Hackathon is proudly hosted by the Thapar School of Liberal Arts and Sciences (TSLAS) in collaboration with Thapar Institute. We bring together diverse minds to solve real-world challenges, blending traditional Japanese precision with forward-thinking technological solutions.
about.team.title: Leadership & Team
about.team.description: Guiding the vision of TSLAS to integrate liberal arts with deep technological inquiry. The Dean champions the Thapar Japan Hackathon as a platform for interdisciplinary excellence, encouraging students to approach complex global problems with a holistic, disciplined mindset.

about.tiet: Thapar University spans 255 acres and is esteemed for academic excellence, holding NAAC accreditation with an A grade and achieving a remarkable rank of 29 in NIRF 2025. The university is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities tailored for hands-on learning and research, empowering students to explore and innovate across various disciplines.
about.tslas: An innovative school within the TIET ecosystem that combines Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Business, and STEM education. Designed to cultivate critical thinking, research aptitude, problem-solving, communication, and analytical skills. Offers students access to TIET's advanced research infrastructure, entrepreneurial ecosystem, and collaborative learning environment. Encourages interdisciplinary approaches where technology meets society, business, and human-centered innovation.
